'''Stuvany Inglen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We assumed the Imperials were constructing a weapon of some kind to further tighten their grip on the galaxy.''"<br />"''They weren't?''"<br />"''They were indeed constructing weapons, but not for the Empire. They were to be distributed here on Lok.|Stuvany Inglen and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StLD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Steal the Lab Data|Lok}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lok_Revenants_leaders_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Stuvany Inglen with the other leaders of the Lok Revenants.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Stuvany Inglen was a member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and a lieutenant of their leader [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]. She used to work in [[Nym's Base|Nym's palace]], in the city known as [[Nym's Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:RtLR" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Inglen was involved in most major operations of the Lok Revenants.<ref name="SWG:RtLR" /><ref name="SWG:StMO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Steal the Mined Ore|Lok}}</ref><ref name="SWG:StLD" /> That year, the Lok Revenants assaulted the [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|hideout]] of their enemies, the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]], to retrieve the valuable [[memory module]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk|Lok}}</ref> Stuvany Inglen tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] involved in this mission to rescue a Lok Revenant who had been captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and was detained in their hideout.<ref name="SWG:RtLR" /> The same year, the Lok Revenants raided an [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial mine]] where the release of an unknown toxic gas had made the [[Mining/Legends|miners]] become completely crazy and very hostile.<ref name="SWG:RtMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Mine Filter|Lok}}</ref> Inglen requested the spacer to steal as much mined [[Ore/Legends|ore]] as possible.<ref name="SWG:StMO" /> Later, the Revenants attacked an [[Imperial Research Facility (Lok)|Imperial research facility]] on Lok to steal experimental weapons developed and produced there.<ref name="SWG:RtrdaI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the research data and IMGGCUs|Lok}}</ref> This time, Stuvany Inglen asked the spacer to steal lab data in the research facility. With the information collected, she eventually discovered that the Empire was constructing weapons to be distributed on Lok, and not for the use of the Imperial forces. Nevertheless, the final purpose of the Empire remained mysterious for Inglen.<ref name="SWG:StLD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stuvany Inglen was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtLR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Stuvany Inglen was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:RtLR" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
